notes:
Lead: VP of Platform (Ben Cho). Heavy emphasis on key custody model — cannot have plaintext model keys in vendor control.

Summary / requirements:
- Primary ask: Private VPC deployment with customer-managed keys (BYOK) and HSM-backed CMKs. Evaluate AWS KMS + CloudHSM, Azure Key Vault + Managed HSM, and GCP KMS with external key import.
- Data residency: all inference logs + prompts must remain in us-east-1. Retention policy: 30 days for debug traces, 7 years for audit logs (compliance team requirement).
- Auditability: full key usage logs (CloudTrail/KeyVault diagnostics) forwarded to customer SIEM; immutable tamper-evident audit export required.
- SSO + SCIM provisioning and RBAC integration with existing IdP (Okta) mandatory.

Technical notes from 2026-03-10 architecture review:
- Prefer envelope encryption: Redwood should accept encrypted model weight keys (customer CMK wraps data keys) — customer unclear on whether Redwood will perform key wrapping or accept pre-wrapped keys. Need clarifying doc.
- BYOK modes discussed: (1) Importable CMKs (GCP) vs (2) customer-managed keys in cloud KMS with grants (AWS KMS) vs (3) dedicated HSM cluster (Azure Managed HSM or CloudHSM). Customer leaning to AWS KMS w/ CloudHSM-backed CMKs for FIPS attestation.
- Bring-your-own-HSM (BYOH) via on-prem HSM + external key provisioning — legal says possible but Ops says network topology and latency risk for inference runtime, prefer VPC-local CloudHSM.
- Key rotation: monthly automatic rotation required; customer wants key versioning and discrete key IDs surfaced in logs.
- Attestation: need proof of HSM FIPS 140-2/3 certs and HSM health checks. Add HSM attestation docs to security FAQ.

POC plan (agreed):
- Phase 1: Small-scale POC in dedicated VPC (us-east-1) running embeddings + chat baseline. Use AWS KMS CMK with grant-based envelope decryption; send sample telemetry to customer SIEM.
- Phase 2: Import test for GCP key material and Azure managed HSM scenario for customers in EMEA later.
- Phase 3: Latency and throughput validation with customer traffic patterns; measure token latency with KMS-backed decryption in path.
